files.AGENTS.md:
# Working with Svod

1. Run `svod active` for open work; run `svod status work/<kind>/<name>` and do only its next step.
2. Kinds: `work/projects`, `work/features`, `work/tasks` (also `kind: hotfix`), `work/research`. The frontmatter of `card.md` names `kind`, `services`, `parent`.
3. Use the skill `svod status` names: `skills/svod-task`, `svod-feature`, `svod-project`, `svod-research`, `svod-questions`.
4. Never guess: add unknowns with `svod ask <record> "<question>"`, ask in the chat, wait for the answer.
5. After the person writes "Approved" (or "Одобряю"), run `svod approve <record> --step <id>`. Never edit `approval.yaml`.
6. Change service code only in the worktrees of `work.yaml`, made by `bash profile/actions/start-task.sh <record>`.
7. Ask the person before push, merge, deploy, credentials or removing a worktree.
8. Write lasting answers to `knowledge/`; read it before asking.
files.README.md:
# Svod store

This store keeps the work on the service repositories next to it (`../app` and so on): what is planned, what was asked, what a person approved and what was checked. The code lives in the services; the store holds the records.

Set it up:

    git init
    svod init --login <your-login>
    svod validate
    svod active

Connect the agent's hooks with `integrations/setup-claude.sh --project <store>` or `integrations/setup-codex.sh <store>` from the framework clone; without the prompt hook no approval can be recorded.

## Records

| kind | where | steps |
|---|---|---|
| project | `work/projects/<name>/` | vision, questions, researches, architecture (`adr/`), approve, breakdown, children, deliver |
| feature | `work/features/<name>/` | brief, questions, breakdown, approve, children, integration, deliver |
| task | `work/tasks/<name>/` | card, questions, contract, approve, implement, checks, deliver |
| hotfix | `work/tasks/<name>/`, `kind: hotfix` | card with `cause`, questions, implement, checks, deliver |
| research | `work/research/<name>/` | question, findings, outcome (hotfix, feature or `knowledge/`) |

Each record has `card.md` with frontmatter `type: card` plus `kind`, `services`, `parent`, `tags`, `status`; see `work/tasks/example/`. `svod record new <pipeline> <name> [--services a,b] [--parent <id>] [--kind hotfix] [--tags a,b]` makes a record from the skeletons in `profile/records/<pipeline>/` (the template ships `card.md` only; add files of your own there); `svod next <record>` prints its next action in one line. A record is done when its card says `status: done`. Approvals live in `approval.yaml` and are written only by `svod approve`.

## Services and actions

Name the services of a task in its card (`services: [app]`). The actions in `profile/actions/` find a service at `SVOD_SERVICE_<NAME>`, else at `services` of `svod.yaml`, else at `../<name>`:

    bash profile/actions/start-task.sh work/tasks/<name>   # svod record new if card.md is missing, a worktree per service, work.yaml
    bash profile/actions/checks.sh work/tasks/<name>       # SVOD_CHECKS_<NAME> or make/npm/go/pytest; checks.md
    bash profile/actions/pr.sh work/tasks/<name>           # the pull request description
    bash profile/actions/cleanup.sh work/tasks/<name>      # after status: done, removes clean worktrees

`svod do <action> <record>` runs the same scripts (`svod do start-task work/tasks/<name>`); it refuses an action of a step the record has not reached unless `--force`, and stops a script after 600 s unless `--timeout <seconds>`. The record given as argument always wins over `SVOD_*` variables inherited from another run.

Worktrees and branches: the worktree of service `<service>` for `work/<kind>/<name>` of pipeline `<pipeline>` (task, feature, ...) is `<service>-<pipeline>-<name>` in the directory holding the service checkout, on branch `<pipeline>/<name>`; `work.yaml` lists it relative to the store root (`app: ../app-task-login`), so it can be committed. A store inside its service gets the worktree next to the service, not inside it.

The steps `checks` (task) and `integration` (feature) also run `checks.sh <record> --check` as a `command` gate: it writes nothing, repeats the checks and passes when they pass; a record without services passes, one without `checks.md` fails without running.

Process changes: `profile/pipelines/*.yaml`, texts in `profile/locale/`, skills in `skills/`; run `svod validate` after each change.
files.knowledge/README.md:
# Knowledge

Lasting answers the team and the agents read before asking again: how a service behaves, why a decision holds, where a value comes from.

- One topic per file: `knowledge/<topic>.md`, a title, the answer first, then the details.
- Open it with frontmatter: `title`, `tags` (a list), `source`, `date`, `status: current`; a file with neither `title` nor `tags` is not a note and stays out of `INDEX.md` and of the agent's context. `svod knowledge note` and `svod knowledge add` write the frontmatter.
- Name the source of every claim: a file, a command, a research record (`work/research/<name>`) or a person and a date.
- A research with `outcome: knowledge` writes its answer here and names the file in its card: `knowledge: knowledge/<topic>.md`.
- Fix a wrong answer in place and say what changed; delete a topic nobody needs.
files.profile/actions/_env.sh:
# Shared environment of the actions, sourced by each: the record, its services and their checkouts.
# The record is the first argument not starting with -- (work/<kind>/<name>, relative to the store
# root, which is the working directory); the options go to OPTIONS. svod do passes no record: it
# sets SVOD_ACTION=<action>, SVOD_ROOT, SVOD_ID, SVOD_KEY, SVOD_KIND, SVOD_PIPELINE, SVOD_SERVICES,
# SVOD_SERVICE_<NAME>, SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH, which are used then. The argument wins over inherited
# variables: when it names a record other than SVOD_ID, or SVOD_ROOT is not the working directory
# (a nested run: checks running tests that run these scripts on another store), every inherited
# record variable, SVOD_SERVICE_<NAME> and SVOD_FM_<NAME> is dropped and found again from the
# argument, card.md and svod.yaml.
#
# Names: the worktree of service <service> for record work/<kind>/<name> of pipeline <pipeline>
# is <directory holding the service checkout>/<service>-<pipeline>-<name>, on branch
# <pipeline>/<name>; work.yaml lists it relative to the store root. <pipeline> is SVOD_PIPELINE,
# else <kind> without its final s (tasks -> task, features -> feature, research -> research).
set -euo pipefail

RECORD=""
OPTIONS=""
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --*) OPTIONS="$OPTIONS $arg" ;;
    *) [ -n "$RECORD" ] || RECORD="$arg" ;;
  esac
done
RECORD="${RECORD#./}"
RECORD="${RECORD%/}"

# has_option <--name>: whether the option was given.
has_option() {
  case "$OPTIONS " in *" $1 "*) return 0 ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
}

HERE="$(pwd -P)"
stale=""
if [ -n "${SVOD_ROOT:-}" ] && [ "$(cd "$SVOD_ROOT" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" != "$HERE" ]; then
  stale=1
fi
if [ -n "$RECORD" ] && [ -n "${SVOD_ID:-}" ] && [ "$RECORD" != "$SVOD_ID" ]; then
  stale=1
fi
if [ -n "$stale" ]; then
  unset SVOD_ACTION SVOD_ROOT SVOD_ID SVOD_KEY SVOD_KIND SVOD_PIPELINE SVOD_SERVICES SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH
  for name in $(compgen -e); do
    case "$name" in SVOD_SERVICE_*|SVOD_FM_*) unset "$name" ;; esac
  done
fi

SVOD_ROOT="${SVOD_ROOT:-$HERE}"
SVOD_ID="${RECORD:-${SVOD_ID:-}}"
if [ -z "$SVOD_ID" ]; then
  echo "usage: $0 work/<kind>/<name> [options]  (run from the store root)" >&2
  exit 2
fi
SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH="${SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH:-$SVOD_ID}"
case "$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH" in /*) ;; *) SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH="$SVOD_ROOT/$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH" ;; esac
CARD="$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH/card.md"
WORK="$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH/work.yaml"

# card_field <name>: a frontmatter field of card.md; a [a, b] list comes out as "a b".
card_field() {
  [ -f "$CARD" ] || return 0
  awk -v k="$1" '
    NR == 1 { if ($0 != "---") exit; next }
    $0 == "---" { exit }
    { i = index($0, ":"); if (i && substr($0, 1, i - 1) == k) {
        v = substr($0, i + 1); sub(/[ \t]+#.*/, "", v); gsub(/[][,]/, " ", v)
        gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", v); gsub(/[ \t]+/, " ", v); print v; exit } }' "$CARD"
}

# svod_cli <args>: the svod command on PATH, else the engine Python imports.
svod_cli() {
  if command -v svod >/dev/null 2>&1; then svod "$@"; else python3 -m svod.cli "$@"; fi
}

# abs <path>: the path itself when absolute, else relative to the store root.
abs() {
  case "$1" in /*) printf '%s\n' "$1" ;; *) printf '%s\n' "$SVOD_ROOT/$1" ;; esac
}

# rel <path>: an absolute path without symbolic links, relative to the store root.
rel() {
  local base target up=""
  base="$(cd "$SVOD_ROOT" && pwd -P)"
  target="$1"
  while [ "$base" != / ] && [ "$target" != "$base" ] && [ "${target#"$base"/}" = "$target" ]; do
    base="$(dirname "$base")"
    up="../$up"
  done
  if [ "$target" = "$base" ]; then printf '%s\n' "${up%/}"
  elif [ "$base" = / ]; then printf '%s%s\n' "$up" "${target#/}"
  else printf '%s%s\n' "$up" "${target#"$base"/}"
  fi
}

# service_path <name>: checkout of a service as configured, relative to the store root or absolute:
# SVOD_SERVICE_<NAME>, else services.<name> of svod.yaml, else ../<name>.
service_path() {
  local var path
  var="SVOD_SERVICE_$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr 'a-z-' 'A-Z_')"
  path="${!var:-}"
  if [ -z "$path" ] && [ -f "$SVOD_ROOT/svod.yaml" ]; then
    path=$(awk -v k="$1" '
      /^services:/ { s = 1; next }
      s && /^[^ \t#]/ { exit }
      s { line = $0; sub(/[ \t]+#.*/, "", line); i = index(line, ":")
          if (i) { n = substr(line, 1, i - 1); gsub(/[ \t]/, "", n)
                   if (n == k) { v = substr(line, i + 1); gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", v); print v; exit } } }' \
      "$SVOD_ROOT/svod.yaml")
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "${path:-../$1}"
}

# service_dir <name>: absolute path of the service checkout without symbolic links; fails when missing.
service_dir() {
  (cd "$(abs "$(service_path "$1")")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)
}

# worktree_of <name>: the worktree of the service recorded in work.yaml, or nothing.
worktree_of() {
  [ -f "$WORK" ] || return 0
  awk -v k="$1" 'index($0, k ": ") == 1 { print substr($0, length(k) + 3); exit }' "$WORK"
}

SVOD_SERVICES="${SVOD_SERVICES:-$(card_field services)}"
SVOD_SERVICES="${SVOD_SERVICES//,/ }"
SVOD_KEY="${SVOD_KEY:-$(card_field key)}"
SVOD_KIND="${SVOD_KIND:-$(card_field kind)}"
SLUG="$(basename "$SVOD_ID")"
if [ -z "${SVOD_PIPELINE:-}" ]; then
  SVOD_PIPELINE="$(basename "$(dirname "$SVOD_ID")")"
  SVOD_PIPELINE="${SVOD_PIPELINE%s}"
fi
BRANCH="$SVOD_PIPELINE/$SLUG"
export SVOD_ROOT SVOD_ID SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH SVOD_SERVICES SVOD_KEY SVOD_KIND SVOD_PIPELINE SLUG BRANCH
files.profile/actions/checks.sh:
# Run the checks of every service in its worktree (work.yaml) or checkout; checks.md on success, checks.log always.
# Usage: bash profile/actions/checks.sh work/<kind>/<name> [--check]. The command: SVOD_CHECKS_<NAME>, else found by the files.
# --check writes nothing: it runs the checks again with their output on stdout and exits with their result, for the
# command gate of the checks step; a record naming no services passes, one without checks.md fails without running.
# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR source=_env.sh
. "$(dirname "$0")/_env.sh"

# check_command <name> <dir>: SVOD_CHECKS_<NAME>, else the usual command of the project in dir.
check_command() {
  local var
  var="SVOD_CHECKS_$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr 'a-z-' 'A-Z_')"
  if [ -n "${!var:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "${!var}"
  elif [ -f "$2/Makefile" ] && grep -q '^check:' "$2/Makefile"; then echo "make check"
  elif [ -f "$2/Makefile" ] && grep -q '^test:' "$2/Makefile"; then echo "make test"
  elif [ -f "$2/package.json" ]; then echo "npm test"
  elif [ -f "$2/go.mod" ]; then echo "go test ./..."
  elif [ -f "$2/pyproject.toml" ] || [ -d "$2/tests" ]; then echo "python3 -m pytest -q"
  fi
}

check=""
if has_option --check; then check=1; fi
log="$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH/checks.log"
report="$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH/checks.md"
if [ -z "$SVOD_SERVICES" ]; then
  if [ -n "$check" ]; then
    echo "no services declared in ${CARD#"$SVOD_ROOT"/}: nothing to check"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "no services: name them in ${CARD#"$SVOD_ROOT"/} as services: [app]" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$check" ]; then
  if [ ! -f "$report" ]; then
    echo "not checked yet: run bash profile/actions/checks.sh $SVOD_ID"
    exit 1
  fi
  exec 3>&1
else
  : > "$log"
  rm -f "$report"
  exec 3>>"$log"
fi
lines=()
failed=0
for name in $SVOD_SERVICES; do
  dir="$(worktree_of "$name")"
  dir="${dir:-$(service_path "$name")}"
  path="$(abs "$dir")"
  cmd="$(check_command "$name" "$path")"
  if [ -z "$cmd" ]; then
    echo "$name: no check command: set SVOD_CHECKS_$(printf '%s' "$name" | tr 'a-z-' 'A-Z_')" >&2
    failed=1; continue
  fi
  if [ -n "$(git -C "$path" status --porcelain)" ]; then
    echo "$name: $dir has uncommitted changes: commit them first" >&2
    failed=1; continue
  fi
  commit="$(git -C "$path" rev-parse --short HEAD)"
  echo "== $name @ $commit: $cmd" >&3
  if (cd "$path" && bash -c "$cmd") >&3 2>&1; then
    lines+=("- $name @ $commit: \`$cmd\` passed")
  elif [ -n "$check" ]; then
    echo "$name: \`$cmd\` failed" >&2
    failed=1
  else
    echo "$name: \`$cmd\` failed, see ${log#"$SVOD_ROOT"/}" >&2
    failed=1
  fi
done
if [ "$failed" != 0 ]; then
  exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$check" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "${lines[@]}"
  exit 0
fi
{ echo "# Checks"; echo; printf '%s\n' "${lines[@]}"; } > "$report"
cat "$report"
files.profile/actions/cleanup.sh:
# Remove the clean worktrees of a record whose card.md says status: done; dirty ones and all branches stay.
# Usage: bash profile/actions/cleanup.sh work/tasks/<name>. Idempotent: a removed worktree is skipped.
# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR source=_env.sh
. "$(dirname "$0")/_env.sh"

if [ "$(card_field status)" != "done" ]; then
  echo "status is not done in ${CARD#"$SVOD_ROOT"/}: nothing removed" >&2
  exit 1
fi
[ -f "$WORK" ] || exit 0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  name="${line%%:*}"
  dir="${line#*: }"
  path="$(abs "$dir")"
  [ -n "$name" ] && [ -d "$path" ] || continue
  if [ -n "$(git -C "$path" status --porcelain)" ]; then
    echo "$name: $dir has uncommitted changes: kept"
    continue
  fi
  git -C "$(abs "$(service_path "$name")")" worktree remove "$path"
  echo "$name: removed $dir (branch $BRANCH kept)"
done < "$WORK"
files.profile/actions/pr.sh:
# Print a pull request description from card.md, contract.md and checks.md of the record; writes nothing.
# Usage: bash profile/actions/pr.sh work/tasks/<name>. Paste the output into the PR of every service.
# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR source=_env.sh
. "$(dirname "$0")/_env.sh"

# body <file>: the markdown without frontmatter, its first heading and HTML comments.
body() {
  [ -f "$1" ] || return 0
  awk '
    NR == 1 && $0 == "---" { front = 1; next }
    front { if ($0 == "---") front = 0; next }
    !title && /^# / { title = 1; next }
    /<!--/ { comment = 1 }
    comment { if (/-->/) comment = 0; next }
    { print }' "$1" | cat -s
}

title="$(grep -m1 '^# ' "$CARD" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^# //' || true)"
echo "${SVOD_KEY:+$SVOD_KEY: }${title:-$SLUG}"
echo
echo "Record: $SVOD_ID; branch: $BRANCH"
body "$CARD"
body "$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH/contract.md"
if [ -f "$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH/checks.md" ]; then
  echo
  body "$SVOD_SUBJECT_PATH/checks.md"
fi
files.profile/actions/start-task.sh:
# Start a task: the record (svod record new) when card.md is missing, then a git worktree per service on branch <pipeline>/<name>, listed in work.yaml.
# Usage: bash profile/actions/start-task.sh work/tasks/<name>. Idempotent: existing files and worktrees are kept.
# The worktree of service <service> is <service>-<pipeline>-<name> in the directory holding the service
# checkout (its absolute path, so a store inside the service gets it next to the checkout, never inside);
# work.yaml lists it as "<service>: <path relative to the store root>", e.g. "app: ../app-task-login".
# shellcheck source-path=SCRIPTDIR source=_env.sh
. "$(dirname "$0")/_env.sh"

if [ ! -f "$CARD" ]; then
  # The record from the skeletons of profile/records/<pipeline>/ (the template ships card.md).
  svod_cli --root "$SVOD_ROOT" record new "$SVOD_PIPELINE" "$SLUG" --kind "$SVOD_KIND" \
    --services "${SVOD_SERVICES// /,}" --key "$SVOD_KEY"
  if [ ! -f "$CARD" ]; then
    echo "no ${CARD#"$SVOD_ROOT"/}: write it like work/tasks/example/card.md" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [ -z "$SVOD_SERVICES" ]; then
  echo "no services: name them in ${CARD#"$SVOD_ROOT"/} as services: [app]" >&2
  exit 1
fi

for name in $SVOD_SERVICES; do
  if ! repo="$(service_dir "$name")"; then
    echo "$name: no checkout at $(service_path "$name"): set services.$name in svod.yaml" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  dir="$(worktree_of "$name")"
  if [ -n "$dir" ]; then
    path="$(abs "$dir")"
  else
    path="$(dirname "$repo")/$name-$SVOD_PIPELINE-$SLUG"
    dir="$(rel "$path")"
  fi
  if [ ! -d "$path" ]; then
    if git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$BRANCH" >/dev/null; then
      git -C "$repo" worktree add "$path" "$BRANCH"
    else
      git -C "$repo" worktree add -b "$BRANCH" "$path"
    fi
  fi
  if [ -z "$(worktree_of "$name")" ]; then
    printf '%s: %s\n' "$name" "$dir" >> "$WORK"
  fi
  echo "$name: $dir on $BRANCH"
done

files.profile/pipelines/feature.yaml:
pipeline: feature
subject:
  provider: work
  params: { roots: [work/features], head_type: card }
active:
  item: work.active.item
  headings:
    mine_idle: feature.active.mine_idle
    theirs: feature.active.theirs
    theirs_collapsed: feature.active.theirs_collapsed
    worktree: feature.active.worktree
done: { gate: field, params: { name: status, equals: done }, text: feature.done, pending: feature.step.close }
steps:
  - id: brief
    title: feature.title.brief
    role: feature
    text: feature.step.brief
    gates:
      - { gate: artifact, params: { path: card.md }, label: work.mark.card, text: feature.step.card }
      - { gate: artifact, params: { path: brief.md }, label: feature.mark.brief }
  - id: questions
    title: work.title.questions
    role: questions
    text: work.step.questions
    gates:
      - { gate: questions_answered, params: { file: questions.md }, label: work.mark.answered }
  - id: breakdown
    title: work.title.breakdown
    role: feature
    required: true
    text: feature.step.breakdown
    gates:
      - { gate: artifact, params: { path: breakdown.md }, label: work.mark.breakdown }
      - { gate: has_children, params: { pipelines: [task] }, label: work.mark.children }
  - id: approve
    title: work.title.approve
    role: feature
    required: true
    text: feature.step.approve
    gates:
      - gate: approval
        purpose: contract
        label: feature.mark.approved
        params:
          marker: brief_approved
          file: approval.yaml
          bind: [brief.md, questions.md, breakdown.md]
  - id: children
    title: work.title.children
    role: feature
    text: feature.step.children
    gates:
      - { gate: children_done, params: { pipelines: [task] }, label: work.mark.children_done }
  - id: integration
    title: feature.title.integration
    role: feature
    required: true
    text: feature.step.integration
    gates:
      - { gate: artifact, params: { path: checks.md }, label: work.mark.checks }
      # checks.sh --check repeats the checks without writing; cached while the store is unchanged:
      - { gate: command, params: { argv: [bash, profile/actions/checks.sh, "{id}", --check], cwd: . }, label: work.mark.checks_pass }
  - id: deliver
    title: work.title.deliver
    role: feature
    optional: true
    text: feature.step.deliver
    gates:
      - gate: approval
        purpose: result
        label: work.mark.result
        params:
          marker: result_approved
          file: approval.yaml
          bind: [checks.md]
violations:
  integration.approve: feature.violation.integration_approve

    role: task
    required: true
    text: task.step.checks
    gates:
      - { gate: artifact, params: { path: checks.md }, label: work.mark.checks }
      # checks.sh --check repeats the checks without writing; cached while the store is unchanged:
      - { gate: command, params: { argv: [bash, profile/actions/checks.sh, "{id}", --check], cwd: . }, label: work.mark.checks_pass }
  - id: deliver
    title: work.title.deliver
    role: task
    optional: true
    text: task.step.deliver

      - gate: approval
        purpose: result
        label: work.mark.result
        params:
          marker: result_approved
          file: approval.yaml

files.skills/svod-feature/SKILL.md:
---
name: svod-feature
description: Use for a record in work/features/<name>/ when svod status names a feature step - brief, breakdown, approve, children, integration, deliver.
---

# Running a feature

1. Run `svod status work/features/<name>` and do only its next step.
2. brief: write `card.md` (frontmatter `type: card`, `services`, `parent`, `tags`) and `brief.md`: problem, users, scope in and out, acceptance.
3. questions: follow `skills/svod-questions/SKILL.md`.
4. breakdown: make one task per independent change, `work/tasks/<task>/card.md` with `parent: work/features/<name>`; list them in `breakdown.md` with one line of result each.
5. approve: show `brief.md`, `questions.md` and `breakdown.md`; after the person writes "Approved", run `svod approve work/features/<name> --step approve`. Never write `approval.yaml`.
6. children: take each task to done with `skills/svod-task/SKILL.md`; check them with `svod status work/tasks/<task>`.
7. integration: after the tasks are merged, run `bash profile/actions/checks.sh work/features/<name>` on the service checkouts; on failure read `checks.log` and open a hotfix task.
8. deliver: show what the feature delivers against `brief.md`; after "Approved" run `svod approve work/features/<name> --step deliver`.
9. Set `status: done` in `card.md` of the feature and report what changed and what stayed unchecked.
files.skills/svod-project/SKILL.md:
---
name: svod-project
description: Use for a record in work/projects/<name>/ when svod status names a project step - vision, researches, architecture, approve, breakdown, children, deliver.
---

# Running a project

1. Run `svod status work/projects/<name>` and do only its next step.
2. vision: write `card.md` (frontmatter `type: card`, `services`, `tags`) and `vision.md`: goal, who gains, measure of success, limits.
3. questions: follow `skills/svod-questions/SKILL.md`.
4. researches: turn each question no one can answer yet into `work/research/<topic>/card.md` with `parent: work/projects/<name>`; run them with `skills/svod-research/SKILL.md`.
5. architecture: record each decision in `adr/<nnn>-<slug>.md` with frontmatter `type: adr`: context, decision, alternatives, consequences.
6. approve: show `vision.md`, `questions.md` and `adr/`; after the person writes "Approved", run `svod approve work/projects/<name> --step approve`. Never write `approval.yaml`.
7. breakdown: make features and tasks with `parent: work/projects/<name>`; list them in `breakdown.md`.
8. children: run each with `skills/svod-feature/SKILL.md` or `skills/svod-task/SKILL.md`; check them with `svod status <record>`.
9. deliver: write each child's outcome into `breakdown.md`, show it; after "Approved" run `svod approve work/projects/<name> --step deliver`.
10. Set `status: done` in `card.md` and report what changed and what stayed open.
files.skills/svod-questions/SKILL.md:
---
name: svod-questions
description: Use when svod status names the questions step of any record in work/, or whenever the work depends on something you do not know.
---

# Asking questions

1. Add everything you do not know that changes the work (behaviour, data, boundaries, effects, priorities) with `svod ask <record> "<question>" --context "<options and what each would change>"`, one call per question; it appends a `## Q:` heading to `questions.md` of the record. When there is nothing to ask, run `svod ask <record> --none`. Never edit `questions.md` yourself: the hook refuses it.
2. Do not invent answers, defaults or "reasonable assumptions". Read the code, `knowledge/` and the record first; ask only what they do not answer.
3. The questions are numbered in file order; `svod ask` prints the number of each.
4. Ask them in the chat in one message, then wait for the person. Do not go on with the step meanwhile.
5. Right after the person answers in the chat, record each answer with `svod answer <record> --q <n> <the person's words>`: it writes `A: …` under question n and works only while the person has just written.
6. Leave an unanswered question open and say so; `svod status <record>` keeps the record here and says how many answers are missing.
7. A new unknown later goes in with `svod ask` and to the chat the same way. A change of `questions.md` voids an approval bound to it: ask for a fresh "Approved".
files.skills/svod-research/SKILL.md:
---
name: svod-research
description: Use for a record in work/research/<name>/ when svod status names a research step - question, findings, outcome - or when a question needs an investigation before any code.
---

# Running a research

1. Run `svod status work/research/<name>` and do only its next step.
2. question: write `card.md` (frontmatter `type: card`, `parent`, `tags`) and `question.md`: the question, why it matters, which answer would change the plan.
3. findings: write `findings.md`: sources, experiments, the answer. Give every claim its source or command; mark guesses as guesses. Change no service code.
4. outcome: set `outcome` in `card.md`:
   - `hotfix` or `feature`: make `work/tasks/<name>/` with `kind: hotfix` or `work/features/<name>/`, then set `leads_to: work/<kind>/<name>`;
   - `knowledge`: write `knowledge/<topic>.md` (see `knowledge/README.md`), then set `knowledge: knowledge/<topic>.md`.
5. Show `findings.md` and the outcome to the person; set `status: done` in `card.md` when they agree.
6. Report the answer in two sentences, its sources and what stays unknown.
files.skills/svod-task/SKILL.md:
---
name: svod-task
description: Use for a record in work/tasks/<name>/ (kind task or hotfix) when svod status names a task step - card, contract, approve, implement, checks, deliver - or before start-task.sh, checks.sh, pr.sh or cleanup.sh.
---

# Running a task

1. Run `svod status work/tasks/<name>` and do only its next step.
2. card: copy `work/tasks/example/` and set `status: open`, or run `bash profile/actions/start-task.sh work/tasks/<name>`; fill `card.md`: `kind`, `services`, `parent`, a hotfix also `cause`; description and acceptance.
3. questions: follow `skills/svod-questions/SKILL.md`.
4. contract: write `contract.md`: result, boundaries per service, effects, checks, risks. A hotfix skips this and the approval.
5. approve: show `card.md`, `questions.md` and `contract.md`; after the person writes "Approved", run `svod approve work/tasks/<name> --step approve`. Never write `approval.yaml`; editing a bound file voids the approval.
6. implement: run `bash profile/actions/start-task.sh work/tasks/<name>`; change code only in the worktrees of `work.yaml` and only what `contract.md` allows; commit with the task key.
7. checks: commit everything, run `bash profile/actions/checks.sh work/tasks/<name>`; on failure read `checks.log`, fix, commit, run again. Never write `checks.md` by hand.
8. deliver: print the PR text with `bash profile/actions/pr.sh work/tasks/<name>`; ask the person before push or a PR; after "Approved" run `svod approve work/tasks/<name> --step deliver`.
9. After the merge set `status: done` in `card.md`, then run `bash profile/actions/cleanup.sh work/tasks/<name>`.
10. Report the result, the commits from `checks.md`, what stayed unchecked and what waits for the person.
files.svod.yaml:
locale: en
profile: profile
default_branch: origin/main
active_order: [project, feature, task, research]
bindings: profile/bindings.yaml
local_config: .svod-local.yaml
approval:
  phrases: [Approved, Одобряю]
  window_minutes: 10
# Service repositories next to the store, name -> checkout; profile/actions/*.sh read them.
# services:
#   app: ../app
autonomy: {task: supervised, hotfix: autonomous, feature: supervised, project: guided, research: supervised}
# Commands with an effect outside this machine (push, merge, deploy, publish) are held by the
# pre-tool hook until a person allows them in the chat; extend or exempt them here:
# external_effects: {deny: [], allow: [], phrases: [go ahead, давай, выполняй]}
# Code freeze: the pre-tool hook keeps edits out of the worktrees work.yaml of a task lists
# until its contract is approved; the task pipeline names the key gate work_id.
workspace_gate: work_tree
evidence: {commit: true}
knowledge: {dir: knowledge, limit_lines: 20}
# What a session starts with: index (the open records from their frontmatter, nothing run),
# summary (the position of every open record: gates, commands, git) or off; index_lines caps
# the index. svod status <record> gives the depth of one record on request.
profile_config:
  agent_context:
    session_start: index
    index_lines: 40

## Description

Greet the user by name on the start page of `app` instead of the generic "Hello".

## Acceptance

- The start page shows "Hello, <name>" for a signed-in user.
- An anonymous user still sees "Hello".

# Contract: EXAMPLE-1

<!--
What the person approves together with card.md and questions.md
(svod approve work/tasks/<name> --step approve). Any edit afterwards voids the approval.
-->

## Result

The start page of `app` greets a signed-in user as "Hello, <display_name>".

## Boundaries

- `app`: the start page template and its view; nothing else.
- Not touched: translations, the user model, other pages.

## Effects

Commits on the task branch in the `app` worktree. Push, merge and deploy only after the person says so.

## Checks

`bash profile/actions/checks.sh work/tasks/<name>` runs the tests of `app`, with a new test for both greetings.

## Risks

An empty `display_name` would print "Hello, "; the fallback and its test cover it.
